Name: Pexo
Tagline: Produce pitch perfect launch videos with precise control
Description: Pexo makes creating your launch video as simple as having a conversation. Share your product, website, or assets. It plans the story, chooses the right AI model for each task, generates and assembles the scenes, and handles voiceover, music, captions, motion graphics, and editing. Leave a comment or circle what you want changed, and Pexo makes the edit. You direct one agent from idea to a finished, on-brand launch video.

Name: Autonomyware
Tagline: Idea to physical product, engineer anything you can imagine
Description: Autonomyware turns your idea into an engineered physical product. Start with your vision and let autonomous AI handle the engineering process end to end. Describe what you want to create, then move from product definition through architecture, risk, CAD, BOMs, code, verification, and manufacturing preparation. One AI-native workspace keeps every decision and engineering artifact connected from idea to implementation.

Name: OpenShip
Tagline: Open source PaaS on your server or in the cloud. No lock in.
Topics: Open Source, SaaS, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: OpenShip is an open source PaaS that runs on our cloud or your infrastructure. Push your code and OpenShip handles builds, deployments, domains, SSL, monitoring, backups, secrets, and the services your apps depend on. Start fully managed on OpenShip Cloud or self host on your own cloud or on prem. Move between them without changing how you deploy. No proprietary runtime. No vendor lock in. Remove OpenShip and your apps keep running. Deploy anything. Own everything.

Name: Macaly Cloud
Tagline: Build and publish sites with your Claude or ChatGPT
Description: Add Macaly Cloud to your Claude or ChatGPT and build websites and apps right from the chat. Macaly provides the database, hosting, domain and 70+ skills the code needs to go live, on the subscription you already pay for. Also works in Claude Code, Codex and Grok Bot.

Name: jambuild
Tagline: Near instant multiplayer vibecoding, just point and talk
Description: A multiplayer vibecoding tool where you talk and point with your mouse, and every change lands in seconds. Has limited credits to try it out, and you can BYO API keys to unlock more usage.

Name: Ferndesk
Tagline: The help center that never goes out of date
Topics: Customer Success, Customer Communication, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Ferndesk is a complete help center with an agent that checks every article against your product, catches what changed, and drafts the fixes for you.

Name: Datastory
Tagline: Turn the world's data into stories worth sharing
Topics: Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics, Data Visualization
Description: Datastory is the no-code platform for data storytellers. Create interactive charts, websites, and reports with AI, and access a growing catalog of open datasets.

Name: lurk
Tagline: Free, open-source Reddit and Twitter lead monitoring
Description: lurk watches Reddit and X for people asking for a product like yours, scores each post with a one-line reason, and sends new ones to email, Slack, Discord or a webhook. Also finds the Reddit threads Google ranks for you. Free and open source.

Name: Campfire
Tagline: The shared workspace for humans and coding agents
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Campfire gives humans and coding agents a shared place to work. Run the coding agents you already use and bring their sessions, context, decisions, and progress together in one workspace. Open source and harness-independent.

Name: CrawlRaven MCP
Tagline: Your SEO work, done from your AI agent
Description: CrawlRaven joins Search Console, GA4, your keyword lists, and a technical crawl of your site into one plan, ranked by impact: what to fix, update and write first. Ask for it in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor through our MCP server and get answers from your own data.

Name: GitBot
Tagline: Build bots on the coding agent you already use
Topics: Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Bots
Description: GitBot turns a job you keep giving Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode into a bot. Write the instructions once, set what it may touch, and run it in any repo. Each run is a thread you can come back to. Install bots other devs made from the Library, or share yours with a code. ShipGuard, for example, reads your branch and says merge or block, with file and line evidence. Runs on your machine with the logins you already have. Open source. No account, no telemetry.

Name: WebinarFlow
Tagline: Your pitch on repeat. You only when it counts.
Description: Record your demo once. Prospects book and watch whenever suits them. Jump in live only when a real question needs you, then keep the recording rolling. Every answer trains an AI that handles the repeat questions next time.

Name: Dental Scope
Tagline: Explore dental anatomy in 3D, tooth by tooth
Topics: Open Source, Education, GitHub, Health news
Description: Dental Scope is a free, open source 3D dental learning tool for exploring teeth and surrounding structures in detail. Explore all 32 permanent teeth, switch between FDI, Universal and Palmer numbering systems, and study structures from enamel and dentin to pulp, root canals, jaws, nerves and vessels.

Name: Cyluma
Tagline: Your Mac’s battery as a living, breathing landscape
Description: Cyluma turns your Mac’s battery into a responsive living landscape. Optimise your battery's health with best parctices. See charge, charging state, time remaining, battery health and energy use from a calm menu-bar companion.

Name: Upsolve Data Models
Tagline: Teach AI your metric definitions and business vocabulary
Description: Register your data model, metric definitions and business vocabulary once. Upsolve grounds every agent answer in them, versions them like code and refreshes column values nightly, so answers stay correct as your data changes.

Name: Squint
Tagline: Drag a box on your screen and ask AI about it
Description: Most AI tools make you screenshot, switch to a chat tab, upload, and switch back. Squint cuts that to one step: press a hotkey, drag a box over anything on your screen, and ask. The answer appears right beside what you selected, and you can ask follow-ups. Fast mode usually starts answering in 1-2 seconds; Best mode gives deeper answers. Built in Rust with native screen capture for speed. Works on Windows 10/11 and Linux (Wayland), with a free tier of 3 captures a day.

Name: Speek
Tagline: A voice assistant that lives in your Mac's notch
Description: Speek is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. Hold a key and talk to dictate into any app, edit selected text, or ask it to take action in your apps and accounts. Point to something on screen by circling it. Speek handles quick requests in the notch and runs longer tasks in the background, then tells you when they are done. It can answer aloud, follow up naturally, and remember details you ask it to keep. Built for macOS.

Name: Aktar
Tagline: Share files instantly from your own cloud. Mac, Windows, iOS
Description: Aktar is a free, open-source app for instantly sharing files through your own S3-compatible storage. Drop a file and Aktar uploads it to S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO or similar storage, then copies the shareable link to your clipboard. Works with any file: screenshots, logs, builds, videos. No accounts, no intermediary servers, and your files stay in your own storage. Available on Mac, Windows and iOS, with Android coming soon.

Name: Bruto
Tagline: A task board that lives in your repo, for you and your AI
Topics: Task Management, Developer Tools, GitHub, Vibe coding
Description: A brutalist task board for coding with AI. Notes live in your repo: copy the context with one key, or let an agent work the board over MCP and answer in each note. Standing rules, cross-project links and a map of your pages, APIs and tables. Free, open source.

Name: Evlat
Tagline: Know which AI coding agent is waiting on you
Description: Evlat is a thin strip on your Mac's screen edge, one ring per Claude Code or Codex session. When one needs a permission or an answer, it turns amber; one click opens its terminal tab. It also tracks long commands and remote servers. Native, no permissions.
